text_cs: Místo zaniklé středověké osady Mury - poprvé v pramenech zmíněna v r. 1226 (zpětně v 2. pol. 12. stol.) v majetku doksanského kláštera. Zaniká povodní ve 14. stol. Dnes na části její původní rozlohy ves Sv. Kliment. ZSO Mury bývalo starší lit. považováno za městečko. Toto tvrzení vyvrátil výzkum O. Kotyzy aj. Smetany (1992). Jednalo se o vcelku velkou ves s více jak 20 staveními. U této vsi poprvé zmíněna emfyteuze - 1226.
text_en: The place that was a former medieval settlement of Mury - first mentioned in the sources in 1226 (retrospectively in the 2nd half of the 12th century) in the property of the Doxan monastery. It was flooded in the 14th century. Today, on part of its original area, there is the village of Sv. Kliment. The former settlement of Smetana was older than the Lit. considered a small town. This claim was refuted by research by O. Kotyz and others. Smetana (1992). It was a fairly large village with more than 20 houses. This village was first mentioned by emfyteuze - 1226.
